question: Queen Rudramadevi belonged to which dynasty of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kakatiya **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Queen Rudramadev**i was a queen of the **Kakatiya Dynasty** in Deccan Plateau from 1263 to 1289 until her death.
 
• She was one of the very few women to rule as a monarch in India and promoted a male image in order to do so.
 
• Rudrama Devi may have died in 1289 while fighting **Ambadeva**, although some sources say she did not die until 1295. She was succeeded by **prataprudra** the son of her elder daughter **Mummadamma**, who inherited a kingdom that was smaller than it had been when Rudrama Devi had ascended her throne.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Chola Dynasty **was a Tamil **thalassocratic empire of southern India, one of the longest-ruling dynasties in world history. The earliest datable references to the Chola are in inscriptions from the 3rd century BCE left by Ashoka, of the Maurya Empire.**
 
• The **Chalukya dynasty** was **established by Pulakeshin** I in 543. **Pulakeshin I took Vatapi under his control and made it his capital. Pulakeshin I **and his descendants are referred to as "Chalukyas of Badami".
 
• **Chera **also known as the** Keralaputra** was one of the **principal lineages in and before the ****Sangam period**** history of the state of Kerala and the Kongu Nadu region of Western Tamil Nadu in southern India. **
